correctness.rationale: Independently re-executed the witness: cycle types (4,2,1^6),(5,4,3),(7,3,2) confirmed, v0*v1*vinf=id holds under compose(a,b)[i]=b[a[i]], group action transitive, RH gives 8+3+3=14 parts and g=0. Ran 01_triple.py and 02_group_id.py: vinf^6 is a 7-cycle, sympy reports order 479001600=12!, transitive and primitive, so L=S12 with trivial centralizer (Aut=1). Brute-force enumeration of all 83160 elements of class (4,2,1^6) against fixed vinf gives N=4088, confirming the character sum; re-ran census.py and nielsen_correct.py yielding 142 classes (66 transitive) and pure-braid singleton for our class. No field-of-definition claim is made, matching the honest limitation.

originality.rationale: Fused search over literal, equivalent (dessin/Hurwitz/S12 xyz=1), and dominance (database/census/classification) directions returned no prior record of passport ([4,2,1^6],[5,4,3],[7,3,2]). Full-text inspection shows the Musty et al. Belyi database covers degrees only through 9, LMFDB Belyi maps cover degrees only through 9, and the Wang et al. Hurwitz-exceptional catalogue lists only non-realizable triples with no parameter match for this passport. Malle's selective fields-of-definition sample is explicitly non-exhaustive ('some passports with restrictions'), not a census covering this passport. No synonymous encoding, dual, broader theorem, table, or database was found that states or implies this exact realizability witness.

value.rationale: TARGET route: the admitted target asked for exactly this decidability — an explicit transitive triple with group/centralizer data or a rigorous obstruction for the fixed genus-0 degree-12 passport. The delivered connected S12 cover over C with trivial Aut plus exact census invariants (N=4088, 142/66 Nielsen classes, braid orbits 1 and 6) resolves the target constructively. The object and invariant were motivated before computation, the value was not known or mechanically implied (RH is only necessary), and a future researcher can reuse the precise witness. Honestly scoped with no Q-descent claim; not a textbook restatement, parameter variant, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration.
